drums.tags: Percussion ensemble piece featuring body percussion and found sounds. The arrangement consists of rhythmic hand claps, chest thumps, and finger snaps layered over a steady, resonant foot stomp. The rhythmic pattern is built on a syncopated 4/4 groove at 112 BPM. A metallic, percussive sound resembling a cowbell or struck metal pipe provides a steady quarter-note pulse. The piece utilizes call-and-response dynamics between different percussive timbres. The mix is dry with minimal room reverb, emphasizing the transient attack of the claps and the low-end resonance of the stomps. No melodic or harmonic instruments are present.
